_comment: Copy this file to data/resume-baseline.json and fill in your real data. The keys you set in `experience[].company` must appear in bullet-library.json's `companyKeyMap`, which maps each company to a role-key (e.g. 'current', 'prior1') under which the bullet pool lives.
name: Your Full Name
summary: 2-3 sentence career narrative. Lead with current scope and one signature outcome. Mention any parallel side-project or consultancy you want visible. The role-keyed bullets below carry the technical depth, so keep this paragraph human and specific — not a feature list.

experience.subtitle: Optional one-line context: team, scope, products, brands, etc.
bullets: Bullets are populated per-posting by lib/bullet-select.js from data/bullet-library.json. The text here is a placeholder — once you're set up, the selector overwrites these per-JD.
